MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  JULY 15, 2025

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 6:05 p.m. at Highridge Park, 29035 Highridge Rd., Rolling
  Hills Estates, California, by VICE CHAIR POPE.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  VICE CHAIR POPE led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Pope, Ciarolla, Bain, and McCormick

  Commissioners Absent:  Persichina, Johnson, and Holdsworth

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF MAY 20,
  2025

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  BAIN to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  MAY 20, 2025.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR POPE so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  NONE.

  6.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  NATURE CENTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
JULY 15, 2025
   Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the Nature Center Services Interim
  Agreement for the upcoming year (as per the agenda material).

  Discussion ensued regarding certain items including confirmation that the
  agreement had been previously negotiated between both parties, that the reduced
  level of service proposed will also be provided by the Palos Verdes Peninsula Land
  Conservancy once construction starts, and that the brush clearance services are
  defined in advance.

  VICE CHAIR POPE stated that the modified service allows for services to be
  offered to the community and keeps a presence at the Nature Center and the
  preserve.

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  BAIN to:

  RECOMMEND TO THE CITY COUNCIL TO APPROVE THE ATTACHED
  INTERIM AGREEMENT FOR NATURE CENTER SERVICES.

  AYES:  Ciarolla, Bain, McCormick, Pope
  ABSENT:  Persichina, Johnson, Holdsworth

  B.  WALL OF RECOGNITION PLAQUE – DAVID WAHBA

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the proposed wall of recognition
  plaque for long time staff member David Wahba (as per the agenda material).

  The Commission concurred that the plaque was well deserved.

  In response to COMMISSIONER BAIN, Supervisor Pinuelas confirmed that the
  plaque would be consistent with the other plaques on the recognition wall.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR POPE to:

  RECOMMEND THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE ADDITION OF A
  BRONZE PLAQUE TO THE RECOGNITION WALL HONORING DAVID
  WAHBA’S TENURE WITH THE CITY.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR POPE so ordered.

  7.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  HILLS ARE ALIVE DEBRIEF

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the 2025 Hills Are Alive Debrief report
  (as per the agenda material).

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
JULY 15, 2025
   VICE CHAIR POPE asked what the difference in net revenue was between this
  year and last year. Coordinator Morrow stated that the difference was
  approximately an increase of $400.

  Discussion ensued regarding announcements of age division medals, volunteers
  for the event, potential local food vendors’ interest to provide coffee and light
  breakfast items at the event, and date of the event.

  The Commission concurred that the change in date was highly favorable due to
  the increase in participation and that the event’s ambiance and atmosphere overall
  was enhanced.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN inquired about the registration software’s ability to pull
  data related participant residency. Coordinator Morrow responded that Staff would
  see if that type of data report is available.

  Commission was very appreciative of Staff’s efforts in putting together a successful
  event for the community.

  B.  CONCERT IN THE PARK UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow provided an update regarding the upcoming Concert in the
  Park event on Saturday, July 19. He provided information regarding the band
  performing at the event and the production company setting up the sound and
  stage.

  A discussion ensued regarding previous Concert in the Park event attendance, the
  average rate for a band to perform at the concert, and the suggestion to look at
  local talent or bands to perform at a future concert.

  C.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  Supervisor Pinuelas put forward the rescheduling of the Ernie Howlett Park tour
  suggesting the Commission consider holding it in August lieu of the park tour of
  the Chandler Preserve. She stated that a Land Conservancy representative
  could still attend the August meeting if held at Ernie Howlett Park to present an
  update regarding the Chandler Preserve. The Commission agreed to hold the
  August meeting at Ernie Howlett Park.
  8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  COMMISSIONER BAIN reported concern regarding the condition of a house near
  Silver Spur Park. Superintendent Goldsmith stated that City representatives are

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
JULY 15, 2025
   aware of the property and discussions have been made to work toward a
  resolution.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  COMMISSIONER BAIN stated that there was a tree along Hawthorne Blvd near
  PV Drive North that appears to be dead. Superintendent Goldsmith responded that
  the tree is on the list for inspection and possible removal.

  9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF MAY 13, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF MAY 27, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  C.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JUNE 10, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  10.  PARK TOURS

  A.  HIGHRIDGE PARK

  The Commission and Staff conducted a park tour around Highridge Park.

  11.  ADJOURNMENT

  VICE CHAIR POPE ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 6:54 PM TO THE NEXT
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON AUGUST 19, 2025, AT
  6:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD AT ERNIE HOLWETT PARK.

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  ___________________________  ___________________________
  Matt Morrow  Lisa Van Ingen Pope
  Community Services Coordinator  Vice Chair, Park & Activities
  Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  4
JULY 15, 2025
